verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework that runs as code in the user's own repository and server. It holds no user account data that could be exported, so an "export all my data and leave" story is a category error for this product type. Vendored component source and FFI or other-runtime adapters are code-portability features, not data export, and are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
